concept: a hobgoblin sniper who picks off torch-bearers from the ridge and never lets them close
an elven marksman of the thorn-wall who nocks three arrows at once and shoots the wings off crows for sport
an orc warlord at the head of his warband, bellowing his troops into a frenzy
a pirate queen who commands from the quarterdeck and turns every blade aside with a laugh
a miller who turns into a boar under the moon and roots up the graves
a doppelganger who wears the faces of the dead and reads what the living are thinking
a dwarven crossbow sergeant who orders a volley and holds the shield line
a sea-hag's daughter who becomes a shark when the tide turns
